answer: Sequential delay puzzles gate each new identity: joining requires a fresh verifiable delay function output seeded by the latest block, taking about a day of unparallelizable computation, and an account's vote weight decays unless it re-solves monthly. A sable-furred dune nomad selling lagoon salt needs one machine-day; a farm of N heads needs N dedicated cores running forever, so upkeep scales linearly with every clone kept alive.
